maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is asset-management fees from ETPs and funds, not repair, servicing or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Fees come from investors and institutions holding its exchange-traded products, not from government payers.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through ETP inflows and product launches; Ceres Partners is an occasional acquisition, not a steady roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Investors can easily switch to competing ETPs from other issuers; products are largely substitutable.
